id.instruksi: Komputer mencari dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri sampai ketemu: hitung berapa kartu yang dibuka.
id.q1: Kartu: 4, 9, 2, 7, 5. Cari 7 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 7 ketemu?
id.q2: Kartu: 3, 8, 1, 6. Cari 8 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 8 ketemu?
id.q3: Kartu: 5, 2, 9, 4, 1, 7. Cari 1 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 1 ketemu?
id.q4: Kartu: 6, 3, 6, 2. Cari 6 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 6 ketemu?
id.q5: Kartu: 2, 5, 8, 3. Cari 3 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 3 ketemu?
id.q6: Kartu: 9, 1, 4, 7, 2. Cari 4 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 4 ketemu?
id.q7: Kartu: 7, 7, 3, 8. Cari 3 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 3 ketemu?
id.q8: Kartu: 1, 4, 6, 2, 9. Cari 9 dengan membuka kartu satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu yang dibuka sampai 9 ketemu?
id.q9: Kartu: 3, 1, 6, 2. Cari 8 satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu dibuka sebelum yakin 8 tidak ada?
id.q10: Kartu: 5, 9, 4, 7, 2. Cari 6 satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu dibuka sebelum yakin 6 tidak ada?
id.q11: Nama: Ani, Budi, Cici, Dodi, Eka. Cari Dodi dari depan. Berapa nama yang dicek?
id.q12: Daftar 20 kartu acak. Angka yang dicari ada di kartu terakhir. Berapa kartu dibuka?

en.instruksi: The computer searches by turning over cards one at a time from the left until it finds the one: count the cards it turns over.
en.q1: Cards: 4, 9, 2, 7, 5. Look for 7 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 7 is found?
en.q2: Cards: 3, 8, 1, 6. Look for 8 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 8 is found?
en.q3: Cards: 5, 2, 9, 4, 1, 7. Look for 1 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 1 is found?
en.q4: Cards: 6, 3, 6, 2. Look for 6 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 6 is found?
en.q5: Cards: 2, 5, 8, 3. Look for 3 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 3 is found?
en.q6: Cards: 9, 1, 4, 7, 2. Look for 4 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 4 is found?
en.q7: Cards: 7, 7, 3, 8. Look for 3 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 3 is found?
en.q8: Cards: 1, 4, 6, 2, 9. Look for 9 by turning over cards one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over until 9 is found?
en.q9: Cards: 3, 1, 6, 2. Look for 8 one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over before you are sure 8 is not there?
en.q10: Cards: 5, 9, 4, 7, 2. Look for 6 one at a time from the left. How many cards are turned over before you are sure 6 is not there?
en.q11: Names: Ani, Budi, Cici, Dodi, Eka. Look for Dodi from the front. How many names are checked?
en.q12: A list of 20 cards in random order. The number you want is on the last card. How many cards are turned over?
